So, welcome, coaches. We are pleased to welcome Fernanda Sagal to the Virtual Grand Slam Coaches Conference. Fernanda has more than 40 years of coaching experience. He is recognized globally as an expert in tennis development, specifically known for his philosophical concepts and achievements around coach development and increasing participation. He is the founder of Sagal Institute for the formation of leaders in tennis development and strategic tennis transformations.
